title: Load the trainers list — master-detail layout renders
steps: Navigate to /dashboard/trainers/view?tab=trainers with a valid org session
Wait for the page to finish loading (PageLoader disappears)
expected: Left panel shows trainer rows (avatar, name, tier badge, session count). Right panel auto-selects the first trainer and shows their KPI tiles and schedule preview. Tier filter pills render above the list.

title: Search/filter — typing filters trainer list client-side with 300ms debounce
steps: Load the trainers tab with at least 2 trainers
Type part of one trainer's displayName or email into the search input
Wait 300 ms
expected: Only matching trainers appear in the left panel list. Non-matching trainers are hidden. Clearing the search restores all trainers.
source: trainers-list-page.tsx:576, useTrainerData.ts:95-104 (filter on name, email, displayName, specialization)

title: Open create-trainer dialog — 'Invite Trainer' button opens the form
steps: Click the 'Invite Trainer' button at the bottom of the left list panel
expected: A Dialog opens with title 'Add Trainer', showing email input and hierarchy scope Select in addition to the profile collapsible. Availability/Services/Commissions sections are NOT shown (edit-only). Submit button reads 'Add Trainer'.

title: Create a trainer — fill email + hierarchy node, submit; trainer appears in list
steps: Open the 'Add Trainer' dialog
Enter a valid email for an existing system user
Select a hierarchy node from the dropdown
Optionally fill displayName, specialization
Click 'Add Trainer'
expected: Dialog closes. Toast shows 'Trainer added successfully.'. The new trainer row appears in the left list. trainers query is invalidated.
persistence: members table (tenant): role='trainer', hierarchyScopeId, userId, status='active'; member_profiles table (tenant): memberId, displayName

title: Edit trainer profile — open edit dialog, change displayName, save; right panel updates
steps: Select a trainer in the left list
Click 'Edit Trainer' (via the detail panel — note: 'Change Tier' and 'Assign Branch' both open the same edit form)
Wait for the Dialog with title 'Edit Trainer' to open
Modify the displayName field
Click 'Save Changes'
expected: Dialog closes. Toast shows 'Trainer profile updated.'. trainerProfiles cache is invalidated. Right detail panel shows the new displayName.
persistence: member_profiles table (tenant): displayName, specialization, bio, phoneNumber, certifications

title: Assign tier — tier assignment is broken; 'Change Tier' button does NOT call assignTier
steps: Select a trainer in the left list
Click 'Change Tier' in the detail panel header
Observe the dialog that opens
expected: A dedicated tier selector should appear, allowing the user to pick a tier and call trainerTiers.assignToMember.
source: trainers-list-page.tsx:412-419 — onEdit(trainer) is called; TrainerFormDialog.tsx has NO tier field; useTrainerActions.ts:102 — assignTier mutation is declared but never invoked anywhere in the page

title: Open edit dialog when no member_profiles record exists — form shows empty fields
steps: Ensure a trainer exists with no member_profiles row (new trainer, profile never saved)
Select the trainer in the left list
Open the edit dialog via 'Change Tier' or 'Assign Branch'
expected: Dialog opens with all profile fields empty (not blocked). Submitting with empty fields should succeed — upsert with empty values is valid.
source: useTrainerData.ts:47 (Promise.allSettled — unfulfilled profile => null); TrainerFormDialog.tsx:68 (trainerToForm maps null to empty string)

title: Buffer time input — set buffer for a service, save, value persists
steps: Open the edit dialog for a trainer who has at least one assigned service
Expand the 'Services' collapsible section
Click the edit (pencil) icon next to a service's buffer display
Enter a number (e.g. 15) in the buffer input
Click 'Save'
expected: Toast shows 'Buffer time updated.' The buffer display for that service now reads '15 min'. Entering empty string sets buffer to null ('Using default').
persistence: member_service_buffer_overrides table (tenant): memberId, serviceId, bufferTimeMinutes (null = deleted = use category default)

title: Suspend a trainer — status badge changes to Inactive; reactivate restores Active
steps: Select an active trainer
Click 'Suspend' in the detail panel header
Observe status badge and list row opacity
Click 'Reactivate'
expected: After suspend: trainer row has opacity-70, detail panel shows red 'Inactive' badge. After reactivate: row shows full opacity, badge shows green 'Active'.

title: No organization selected — guard message shown instead of list
steps: Simulate or navigate to the trainers tab when userContext.currentOrganizationId is null (e.g. during org switching)
expected: Page shows 'Select an organization to manage trainers.' centered in the content area. No list, no error callout.

title: Create trainer — email not found in system returns NOT_FOUND toast
steps: Open 'Add Trainer' dialog
Enter an email that does NOT exist in the system (e.g. nonexistent@example.com)
Select a hierarchy node
Click 'Add Trainer'
expected: Dialog stays open (or closes — depends on useApiMutation). Error toast shows the server message: 'User with email nonexistent@example.com not found. User must be registered first.'

title: Create trainer — email already a member returns CONFLICT toast
steps: Open 'Add Trainer' dialog
Enter an email for a user already a member of this org
Click 'Add Trainer'
expected: Error toast: 'User is already a member of this organization'

title: Create trainer — submit with empty email shows toast validation error
steps: Open 'Add Trainer' dialog
Leave the email field blank
Select a hierarchy node
Click 'Add Trainer'
expected: Toast fires 'Email is required.' Form is NOT submitted to the server.

title: Create trainer — submit with no hierarchy node selected shows toast validation error
steps: Open 'Add Trainer' dialog
Enter a valid email
Leave the hierarchy scope unselected
Click 'Add Trainer'
expected: Toast fires 'Hierarchy scope is required.' Form is NOT submitted.

title: Tier filter pill — filter list by tier ID client-side
steps: Load the trainers tab when at least 2 active tiers exist with trainers assigned
Click a tier name pill (e.g. 'Senior')
Observe the left list
expected: List shows only trainers whose trainerTierId matches the selected tier. 'All' pill is no longer active. Clicking 'All' restores the full list.

title: weeklyStatsBatch fails for staff-role users — session counts show '…' for all trainers
steps: Log in as a staff-role member (not admin)
Navigate to the trainers tab
expected: Session counts in the left list panel show '…' indefinitely because trainers.weeklyStatsBatch requires user_management:approve which staff do not have. No error toast is shown (query fails silently).

title: Availability editor — save with endTime <= startTime is rejected by server
steps: Open the edit dialog for a trainer
Expand 'Weekly Availability'
Add a Monday shift
Set endTime equal to or earlier than startTime (e.g. start=10:00, end=09:00)
Click 'Save Availability'
expected: Server returns BAD_REQUEST. Toast shows the error message about invalid time range.
source: trainer-availability.service.ts:78-80 (validation: endTime <= startTime throws); trainerAvailabilityRouter.upsert wraps in BAD_REQUEST

title: Availability upsert silently resets 'blocked'/'timeoff' slots to 'available'
steps: Manually create trainer_availability rows with kind='blocked' or kind='timeoff' in the DB
Open the edit dialog and expand Weekly Availability
Click 'Save Availability' without changes
expected: BUG: all slots are re-saved with kind='available' because TrainerAvailabilityEditor does not track or send the kind field. The server schema defaults kind to 'available'.
source: trainer-availability-editor.tsx:100-115 (slots map omits kind); trainer-availability.ts:96-108 (kind: kindSchema.default('available'))

title: Assign Branch button is a no-op — branch cannot be changed from the UI
steps: Select a trainer
Click 'Assign Branch' in the detail panel
expected: BUG: 'Assign Branch' opens the profile edit dialog (same as 'Change Tier'), which has no hierarchyScopeId field in edit mode. Branch reassignment is impossible from this page.
source: trainers-list-page.tsx:420-430 (onClick calls onEdit); TrainerFormDialog.tsx:158 (!isEditing guard hides email+scope fields)

title: API error loading trainers — error callout with retry button shown
steps: Simulate a network/server error on the members.list call (e.g. revoke permission or kill server)
Navigate to the trainers tab
expected: StatusCallout with variant='error' and title 'Couldn't load trainers' is rendered with a retry button. Clicking retry re-issues the query.
source: trainers-list-page.tsx:637-646 (isError branch renders StatusCallout with onRetry)

title: Services section — assign and remove a service with checkbox
steps: Open the edit dialog for a trainer
Expand the 'Services' section
Check a service checkbox to assign it
Uncheck it to remove it
expected: Assign: no toast but query re-fetches and service appears checked. Remove: service clears and buffer override is also deleted.
persistence: service_members (tenant): memberId, serviceId; member_service_buffer_overrides (tenant): deleted on remove

title: Commissions section — lazy-loads last 20 commission rows on open
steps: Open the edit dialog for a trainer who has commission records
Expand the 'Commissions' section
expected: Table renders with Date, Source, Amount, Status columns. Up to 20 rows shown. No pagination control. A trainer with no commissions shows 'No commission records found.'

title: Category buffer defaults — visible in Services section when category overrides exist
steps: Ensure a trainer has services assigned and category buffer overrides configured
Open the edit dialog and expand Services
expected: A 'Category Buffer Defaults' subsection appears with CategoryBufferRow components per category. Editing and saving a category buffer updates the category_buffer_overrides table.

title: Empty state — no trainers in org shows empty state with 'Invite Trainer' CTA
steps: Navigate to trainers tab in an org with zero trainer-role members
expected: Left panel shows a Users icon, 'No trainers yet' heading, and 'Invite a trainer to get started.' subtext. Right panel shows 'No trainer selected' placeholder.
